denoise.note: Hashed EcoKit alpha + dense stamp cards + 24-sample OIDN smears canopy edges into clumps. This is a secondary blur, not the primary missing-leaf-card cause.

summary.whyLeafOverlaysFailed: Overlays are sparse Corylus cards/twigs (906 objects) sprinkled on EcoKit stamp-clump canopies. Camera rays still hit the original Tree_* masses (overlay share 0.066). Cards were biased off the central sky hole, so they never replace the soft green volume the 42 mm camera actually sees.
summary.whySunDidNotReachTrunks: Foreground/midground EcoKit canopies are dense overlapping stamp volumes. Rays from trunk midpoints toward the key sun hit the tree's own canopy (7/8 blocked). A harder key or trunk kicker cannot paint a warm camera-facing bark side if the clump is an opaque lid. Flood-dapple was already proven to flatten the key and over-warm the soil without creating a sunlit trunk side.
summary.bestRepairPath: Stop overlaying more cards on EcoKit clumps. The camera-visible trees are the wrong asset class for 42 mm / 14-28 m. Replace Tree_* at y<18 with already-purchased Botaniq Full deciduous hero trees (Fagus/Salix) if those .blend files can be recovered unpaid from the owned Botaniq Full pack. Keep EcoKit Tree_* only at y>=18. After real leaf-card canopies with gaps exist, retune a camera-side sun so trunk faces and floor patches receive light. Raise still samples / disable denoise for the next proof. Do not start final video. Do not buy new assets.
